iam.loginDescription: Enter your credentials to access the platform.
iam.noAccount: Do not have an active account?
iam.brandDescription: A shared space for health professionals and the family care network. Review records and alerts for your older family members.
iam.invalidCredentials: Incorrect account. Check your email and password.
iam.loginUnavailable: Unable to sign in. Check that the API is available and has the users resource.

enrollment.title: Create your account
enrollment.description: Register as a doctor or as a family caregiver responsible for a patient.
enrollment.familyHint: Add your details, your patient and their initial measurements.
enrollment.doctorHint: One form for clinic doctors and independent doctors.
enrollment.passwordHint: Use 8 to 72 characters and enter the same password twice.
enrollment.independentDoctor: You will register as an independent doctor.
enrollment.serviceType: Who will provide care for your patient?
enrollment.noDoctors: There are no doctors for this selection. Choose another clinic or service type.
enrollment.simulationNotice: Complete every measurement. These are simulated values, not readings from a device. Systolic pressure must be higher than diastolic pressure.
enrollment.consent: As the responsible family caregiver, I authorize linking my patient to the selected doctor so they can access their information in this simulation.
enrollment.invalidForm: Complete the required fields with valid values. Passwords must match. If registering a patient, complete every vital sign.
enrollment.catalogUnavailable: Clinics and doctors could not be loaded. Check that the backend is running.
enrollment.unavailable: Registration could not be completed. Please try again.
enrollment.duplicateAccount: The email address or professional license is already registered. Check your details or sign in.
enrollment.backLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
enrollment.doctorSuccess: Your doctor account is ready. Sign in with the email and password you registered.
enrollment.familySuccess: Your account, patient, responsible doctor and four simulated measurements have been saved. Sign in to see the dashboard.
